paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss of a reward model over a series of training steps. The x-axis, labeled 'Training Step', has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1400, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis, labeled 'Training Loss', also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.3 to 0.7 (though values below 0.3 are visible), with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. A single blue solid line represents the training loss, starting at approximately 0.8 at a training step of 0, and decreasing sharply to around 0.35 by step 200, after which it fluctuates between approximately 0.3 and 0.4, continuing this fluctuation with a slight decrease until it stabilizes around 0.3 by step 800, remaining relatively steady with continued fluctuations until the end of the plotted range at step 1400.
